title: Password field
description: A password input with a show/hide toggle and error messages. The lock reacts when you click into the field, and the eye morphs open and closed with the toggle.
pageTitle: Password Input with Show/Hide Toggle & Validation | Lordicon

whenToUse.text: Use it in sign-in, sign-up and password change forms. The show/hide toggle helps people avoid typos, especially on mobile, and inline errors explain exactly what's wrong instead of a generic failure. The animated lock and eye make the field's state clear at a glance.
whenToUse.alt: Animated password field: lock reacts on focus and eye icon morphs open and closed with the show/hide toggle

accessibility: A visible label is linked to the input, and the error message is connected with `aria-describedby`.
The toggle is a native button named "Show password", and `aria-pressed` says whether the password is shown.
Errors are shown with text, not color alone.
